query.default: WITH CTE AS ( SELECT *, MAX(receiveddate) OVER (PARTITION BY {0}) AS MaxReceivedDate FROM dirrx_nninteg_companyqueue ) SELECT * FROM CTE WHERE receiveddate < MaxReceivedDate and {0} is not null and (processstatus = 'Recent' or processstatus = 'Retry');

WITH MaxDate AS ( SELECT CompQueueBuf.busUnit AS bu, MAX(CompQueueBuf.LastProcessing) AS max_date FROM ( SELECT businessUnit_company_Sungero AS busUnit, LastProcessing FROM public.dirrx_nninteg_companyqueue AS CompQueue JOIN public.sungero_core_recipient AS dep ON CompQueue.Department = dep.Id UNION ALL SELECT BusinessUnit_Company_SUngero AS busUnit, LastProcessing FROM public.dirrx_nninteg_companyqueue AS CompQueue JOIN public.sungero_company_jobtitle AS jt ON CompQueue.JobTitle = jt.Id JOIN public.sungero_core_recipient AS dep ON jt.Department = dep.id UNION ALL SELECT dep.BusinessUnit_Company_SUngero AS busUnit, LastProcessing FROM public.dirrx_nninteg_companyqueue AS CompQueue JOIN public.sungero_core_recipient AS emp ON emp.Id = CompQueue.Employee JOIN public.sungero_core_recipient AS dep ON dep.Id = emp.Department_Company_Sungero ) AS CompQueueBuf GROUP BY CompQueueBuf.busUnit ) SELECT bu.Id FROM public.sungero_core_recipient AS bu JOIN MaxDate ON bu.id = MaxDate.bu AND MaxDate.max_date < '{0}';

WITH check_existing AS ( SELECT 1 FROM public."MessagesSupernikaStatus" WHERE "RXIncomingMessageId" = @rxIncomingMessageId AND "MBMessageId" = @mbMessageId AND "DateTime" = (@dateTime::timestamptz) AND "Status" = @status AND "SelectedButton" = @selectedButton AND "Comment" = @comment AND "ErrorMessage" = @errorMessage ) INSERT INTO public."MessagesSupernikaStatus" ("RXIncomingMessageId", "MBMessageId", "DateTime", "Status", "SelectedButton", "Comment", "ErrorMessage") SELECT @rxIncomingMessageId, @mbMessageId, @dateTime::timestamptz, @status, @selectedButton, @comment, @errorMessage WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM check_existing);
